note: Exact reviewed source boundary. File completeness is checked against a live independent inventory, including dot paths and .min.js; symbolic links in the five roots are rejected, including dangling links. Unrelated source additions do not require fixture updates. Maintenance: added/removed routes, HTTP modules or plugin addRoute entry points require boundary review and updating sorted requestRoots from the assertion diff, preserving concurrent additions. Changed package.json/tsconfig contents or added resolution inputs require resolution review and updating resolutionInputs paths and full-file SHA256 values from the diff. Added, removed, changed or newly resolved gaps, including any edit to a gap-bearing file, require per-item review and updating reviewedGaps entries, sourceHash and review reasons from the diff; never auto-accept gaps. Rerun the closure guard after each reviewed update; directEdges, reverse and testEdges still require separate boundary review if changed. Dynamic calls, CJS execution of non-source extensions, and runtime entry loading from test-named paths (including plugin manifest main targets) remain outside this static proof; followed test edges are registered but excluded entry paths and manifest-selected targets are not exhaustively proven.
